decisions.reason: The charting bundle has its own page and shows active release momentum, and in a growing industry it meets aspirations as a low-cost extension of the map.apps line.
This small plugin is close to the core offer and cheap to maintain, so slack in a growing market lets the firm carry it despite only a brief website mention.
The mobile layer control was announced as a new approach on the home page but is an experimental component, so its results are uncertain, though slack makes keeping it likely.
As the flagship platform defining the firm's direction, it sits at the centre of the firm's aspirations and is very unlikely to be dropped.
Mobile field data capture fits the firm's enterprise GIS customers well and has its own page, which suggests satisfactory results.
